title: My Hobby MMO
author: SquizzOC
selftext: So this still need a number of art passes, but this is my expect into creating an MMO and it’s starting to look like a game.

comments.author: Outrageous-Issue9722
comments.body:
That's looking great. I'm envious of the art. I've had to pick a simpler style to stay consistent.

https://preview.redd.it/iewwnw0t2euh1.png?width=2559&format=png&auto=webp&s=6c9b29c2c9f843f18aedcd01118e8b9d8276a73c

replies.author: SquizzOC
replies.body:
I’ve had three agents running for two days doing pass after pass to create the rule set for all other zones. Once I get the frame work in place, I’ll go through and audit every texture and asset to get it to the exact art style I’m aiming for which is more in line with this.

It’s been a lot of fun, lots of learning, but long way to go till anything is even testable. Super fun though.   

Keep pushing your tools, you can get the art to any level you want, just takes a lot of time unfortunately

replies.author: SquizzOC
replies.body: What are you using to build your assets?

replies.author: Outrageous-Issue9722
replies.body: Blockbench, because it integrates very nicely with my editor. I can export everything without really touching anything.. so from the editor I can open the source asset, make a change, exit, then the editor immediately picks up the changes. It's made things very smooth

replies.author: SquizzOC
replies.body: I’ll need to investigate, always happy to add another tool to my kit

replies.author: Outrageous-Issue9722
replies.body: The main advantage is that .bbmodel files are pure json.  Very easy for Claude to work with.

replies.author: tothjm
replies.body: What did you use to build the models and 3d world?  Did Claude connect directly?

replies.author: SquizzOC
replies.body: Tripo built some of the assets to start, but always well modified in blender and unreal, through their MCP servers. So my prompts all go into Claude or ChatGPT and they build it.

replies.author: SquizzOC
replies.body:
I’d suggest watching a number of YouTube videos to get started and just asking Claude how to get started?  

I spent three weeks having ChatGPT ask me 20-59 questions a day to build out a game treatment, then took a modified task manager dashboard and had Claude build out over 1,000 tasks to get started.  

Once that was done I built tools to automate the process, the review process and just work for me 24x7.  

Best place to start is to ask Claude how to get started

replies.author: SquizzOC
replies.body: Thanks, the systems to me are easy to build out, the Netcode will not, but if the game doesn’t look like a world I want to explore, then it’s all pointless. So I need to prove I can get the exact art style done, then systems, then netcode for the hosted server set up

comments.author: KorsAirPT
comments.body:
Why a MMO? Why not start by a simpler single player RPG? Not judging, but I always find it funny when most people start by trying to create a game in one of the most complex genres. 

The amount of challenges when creating a game like this are endless, even with AI.

But it's looking good, no doubt about that, good job I guess.

replies.author: SquizzOC
replies.body: Because I wanted to build a game I’d play, I’m not a fan of solo games, prefer MMO’s. Wouldn’t haven’t built anything else otherwise

replies.author: KorsAirPT
replies.body:
I understand, I subscribed Opus 5.5 after seeing all the stuff here, started creating a game and ended up going to bed at 3 am that day, got addicted to the process lol

I'm having a lot of fun developing the game even though I'm not thinking about publishing it.

replies.author: SquizzOC
replies.body: Because of the under taking, this will never be published, unless income how magically create the dream mmo which… not likely. But it’s fun.

comments.author: Xancrazy
comments.body: Any way to keep track of your progress?

replies.author: SquizzOC
replies.body:
Follow me on Reddit, if I get to a state that is truly playable, I’ll build a subdomain on the games main domain to follow development.  

I’ve been at a work event for my day job all week, so most of this has been done remotely through a dashboard I built that connects the three Claude agents (all max plan and assigned to partners that will be stepping in to help when I get back to follow Claude’s ToS), Two ChatGPT and one Gemini. Gemini is worthless. I access the dash from a laptop or my phone to make sure tasks never stop.  

Once home will go through the main playable space and focus on making it match the concept art perfectly, if I can get that done, I’ll keep going and start posting
